title: Jim Lacatski of the DIA, part of AAWSAP, writing about the program

tellings.quote: And then the weird thing is you have Jim Lacatski coming out, you know, who is is DIA rocket scientist involved in ASAP and he's now writing about this stuff

plain: A rocket scientist named Jim Lacatski, from the Defense Intelligence Agency, the US military's spy agency, took part in AAWSAP, a government programme set up around 2008 to study strange aerial threats, UFOs among them. Michels says Lacatski is now coming out and writing about it. Michels tells this himself and calls it weird, since it means an insider is going public about the programme's work.
